prompts.mercury:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct ONLY the geology/environment in this AURORA METAL WORLD reference board. Preserve all existing buildings, layout, stylized flat low-poly rendering, original AURORA ivory/navy/gold palette, framing and labels.
Remove the turquoise/blue ocean-like rim along the lower-left and bottom of the planet: replace it with continuous dark blue-gray/charcoal solid basalt surface curving naturally around the sphere. This volcanic planet has NO ocean anywhere. Remove all little outdoor green trees/grass around the greenhouse building on the right: only vegetation sealed INSIDE greenhouse glass may remain. The land outside is dry basalt.
Remove the circular necklace of tiny crystals and the circular paved loop enclosing the upper-left crystal harvester: replace their ground with irregular unbroken basalt and just one narrow access spur meeting its doorway. Likewise eliminate any circular road or round cleared/tinted patch around other buildings; use footprint-only foundations and thin genuinely connected access paths. Main building shapes and round reactors/domes stay unchanged. Keep natural continuous large irregular plateaus, recessed branching lava rifts and the mining escarpment. No new buildings, no extra stones, no uniform terrain tiling. Apply the same environmental corrections to both the large globe and far-side globe and the detail view. Do not alter the color of building lights.
prompts.mars:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct ONLY the environment in this AURORA CRYSTAL RIFTS reference board. Preserve red canyons, geology, building shapes and locations, crystal veins, clear original AURORA color palette, flat low-poly style, framing and labels.
Remove all turquoise/blue ocean-like surface strips on the far right rim and lower edges of both globe views; replace with dry rust-red/orange rock continuing smoothly around the sphere. This world has NO ocean or terrestrial coast. Cyan is confined to actual crystal veins or building lights; there is no blue water body.
Replace the artificial concentric circular excavation behind the lower-left yellow drill with a jagged naturally eroded open ore escarpment with two irregular stepped benches, integrated into the existing canyon wall; no round pit, circular stamp, round mountain or round construction clearing. Preserve the yellow drill in front. Remove any closed ring road or round paved region around a building, replacing it with continuous red soil and a branching access spur confined to real entrances. Natural irregular mesas remain broad continuous terrain, not raised building tokens. Apply to large globe, far side and detail where relevant. Do not add ground disks or change the architecture.
prompts.moon:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference 1 is the edit target, the AURORA LUNAR FOUNDRY planet board. Reference 2 is the CORRECT floating Flagship_Center with half-built Iron_Behemoth. Reference 3 is the required Wormhole_Generator.
Preserve reference 1's gray low-poly moon geography, natural craters, flat AURORA lighting, blue-gray/ivory/gold material palette, complete-globe framing, detail inset and layout.
Correct facility identities: the moon has FOUR major facility types: three-lobed Moon_Base and its small support pods; dual-crescent scanner; hexagonal Wormhole_Generator; floating Flagship_Center. REPLACE the purple crystal mine currently near the lower-left front hemisphere with the hexagonal wormhole gate from reference 3 and its three little supporting pods, on the same continuous gray ground with NO circular platform. REMOVE the extra large conventional single-dish radar at middle-right and the large solar field at lower-right; replace them with undisturbed gray geology and modest connected habitat support pods only. Remove corresponding extra mines/large solar fields/conventional radar/huge unrelated towers from the far-side view. Tiny communications dishes on habitat support pods are fine. No purple mineral mine on this moon.
Correct the carrier inside the hovering shipyard: match reference 2's HALF-BUILT Iron_Behemoth, WIDE FRONT at the camera-near end, narrow rear under the far command bridge, two widely separated forward prongs, one broad armored shoulder and exposed keel/ribs on the other half. NO pointed narrow bow or long rocket. Ship and paired floating dock rails are distinct separated objects. The shipyard and all its four small support platforms hover clearly above the basin, no landing feet or floor bridging the central void. Make the same corrected carrier in the close-up.
Keep every grounded structure directly integrated into the natural lunar surface with small individual footprint-shaped foundations; natural craters are allowed, artificial circular construction pads are not. No green outdoors. Only retain greenery INSIDE the habitat greenhouse.
